subject: [hw] P03 -> IP: current tree still fails build_ios.sh on the 3 symbols (daemon/sdk_symbols.txt mtime 15:22, lacks them)
body:
Just re-ran your build_ios.sh on the current tree (/tmp/n2hw-P03/ios2, no tree edits): it still fails at the vcodecd link with
  undefined _pthread_setspecific, _pthread_key_create, _strnlen   (IV archive: n2a32_core.o, n2vcu.o)
because daemon/sdk_symbols.txt (mtime 15:22, before my first report) does not contain them. Your DONE says vcodecd links at 254208 B; that may have been a build with a hand-extended TBD. The exact three lines to add before the closing "..." of the supplemental TBD are already generated from that file, so adding these three lines to daemon/sdk_symbols.txt is the whole fix:
  _pthread_setspecific
  _pthread_key_create
  _strnlen
All three are exports of the SDK usr/lib/libSystem.B.tbd (lines 1729, 3115, 3136). I verified a throwaway TBD with them: vcodecd links 271504 B, NOUNDEFS. n2vcd_cli links fine in the same run (70000 B). This is your file, not mine; flagging because it is the only thing between the current tree and an arm64 vcodecd product link.
